jsonLd.description: This beautiful suite was fully renovated in 2025. It combines 1950s spaciousness and oak floors with a modern kitchen and bathroom.  Please note that photos in this ad are of an identical suite in the building that is furnished. The suite now on offer is unfurnished.  Rent includes heat and hot water. The living room is a massive 19’10” by 12’7”, the master bedroom is 13’9” by 12’7” while even the “small” bedroom--at 12’1” by 12’7”—can comfortably accommodate a king-size bed. There is ample closet space as well, including a large linen closet. This very bright, south-facing suite features new premium TRIPLE-glazed windows (three layers of glass) that provide maximum protection against cold in winter (0.99 U-factor) and solar heat gain in summer (0.28 SGHC) as well as maximum reduction of outside noise. There is minimal traffic noise in any event as this suite is located the at back of the building, away from 10th Avenue.  Also, there is a new air conditioner to maintain comfortable temperatures. The expanded kitchen features lots of convenient storage space, a premium self-cleaning LG range with INDUCTION cooktop and an oven that includes AIR FRYER and convection modes. This is also an LG bottom-freezer fridge and a quiet Blomberg dishwasher. Located in Point Grey Village, with its shops, restaurants, coffee places, banks, hair dressers, dental offices, yoga-pilates-meditation studio and public library. There is excellent public transportation on 10th Avenue to UBC, downtown and points west via #99 B-Line and #14. The campus centre is a 15-minute bike ride. The building is in the catchment area for Queen Mary Elementary and Lord Byng Secondary. Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach and Pacific Spirit Park are all within a maximum half-hour walk. The suite is located in a very well-maintained 12-suite apartment building that features• a laundry room with secure bicycle storage and video surveillance• security cameras covering building entrances and exterior walkways• cellphone-controlled entry system that allows you to remotely open building front door• bright interior and exterior lightingSmoking or vaping is not allowed in the suite or the building. A one-year lease and tenant’s insurance are required. Please call or write to arrange viewing.
